explanation: Navigation attempts in the router. navigationAttempts.test.tsx pins that a search, Home, openInExplorer, filter, library record or emptied compare set made while a cold #/dataset/<id>/<track> link is landing wins after that metadata resolves or rejects (B2), that a followed explicit default-track link is canonicalized in place so Back leaves it (B4), that an unrecognized anchor is kept at boot and mid-landing (B8), that a shell tab click supersedes a boot landing, and that settings-only and no-hash initialView writes still replace. appRouter.test.tsx now awaits the verified openInExplorer(id, track) and resets history with replaceState so a late hashchange cannot supersede the next test.
